用户的原始要求（硬性）：
- 为 Windows 版「光标朗读」做 Android 版，功能对齐 Windows v0.5（光标/选中文字朗读、开始/暂停/继续/停止、TTS 引擎和语音设置、音色包导入+试听、标点停顿、语速、多音字前端+用户词库）。
- Android 上无法实现的用最接近的系统方式替代（无障碍服务读取选中/焦点文字、悬浮按钮、分享菜单朗读）。
- 完全离线、体积小、低端手机（4GB 内存、2 核也要能流畅）、黑白灰日式极简界面；最低 Android 6（API 23）。
- 用户是编程初学者、眼睛不好：操作要少、结果一次说清。

下面是我的设计与功能对齐表，以及核心源码。请你作为严格的 Android 资深工程师审查，**不要附和我，也不要附和用户**，客观地挑毛病、给更好的方案：
1) 对齐表里哪些替代方式不是“最接近”的、漏了 Windows 哪些功能、哪些 Android 限制我没考虑（Android 6~16 各版本差异：后台启动前台服务限制、受限设置、通知权限、16KB 页、厂商 ROM 杀后台、无障碍覆盖层等）；
2) 代码里的真实 bug（线程/并发、AudioTrack 暂停/停止、状态机竞争、ANR 风险、内存、zip 导入安全、无障碍节点泄漏/回收、API 等级）；
3) 对初学者用户的易用性问题。
请按严重程度排序，给出编号、具体位置（文件+函数）、为什么、怎么改。不确定的标“推测”。中文回答，不超过 1500 字。

===== DESIGN =====
# 光标朗读 · Android v0.5 — 设计与功能对齐

目标：功能对齐 Windows v0.5（离线中文朗读：从光标处/选中文字朗读、开始/暂停/继续/停止、音色包+导入+试听、标点停顿、语速、线程、多音字前端 A 版、用户词库、关于/许可）。
同时保留 Android v0.2 已有的「系统 TTS 引擎」（阅读 App 可直接用）。

## 技术栈（沙盒里能真正编出 APK 的方案）
- Kotlin 2.4 + 纯 Android SDK（无 AndroidX/Compose），不用 Gradle：kotlinc → R8 → aapt2 → 打包 → zipalign -P 16 → apksigner v1+v2+v3。
- sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 官方 AAR（与 Windows NuGet 同版本），arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a。
- minSdk 23（Android 6.0），targetSdk 36。高版本 API 都用 SDK_INT 判断保护；构建时用 API 23 的 android.jar 再编译一遍，所有“API 23 不存在”的调用必须在 tools/api_allow.txt 登记（静态检查）。
- 同一签名（keystore/release.p12），可覆盖升级 v0.1/v0.2。

## 借鉴的同类开源项目（动手前调研）
| 项目 | 借鉴点 |
|---|---|
| k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx `android/SherpaOnnxTtsEngine` | TextToSpeechService 结构（v0.1 起已用） |
| HayaiApp/HayaiTTS（GPL-3） | SAF 导入自定义音色包（.tar.bz2 → 我们用 .zip/文件夹）、音色放 filesDir/voices、单色设计 |
| maxwhipw/marmalade-tts-android（MIT） | 前台播放服务（锁屏继续读）+ 分享文本 + 系统「朗读选中」入口 + 应用内许可页 |
| NachiketaVadera/Speak、T2S | ACTION_PROCESS_TEXT：选中文字菜单里加“朗读” |
| chiara-select2speak、Orion、Google Select to Speak | 无障碍服务 + 悬浮按钮（TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY，不需要“悬浮窗”权限） |
| jing332/tts-server-android、SherpaTTS | 中文用户习惯：系统 TTS 引擎 + 阅读 App（legado 等）调用 |

## 功能对齐表（Windows v0.5 → Android v0.5）
| Windows v0.5 | Android v0.5 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 全局快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+R：开始→暂停→继续 | ① 悬浮朗读条主按钮 ② 实体键盘同款快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+R（无障碍服务过滤按键）③ 系统无障碍按钮/手势（Android 8+）④ 通知栏「暂停/继续」 | 手机没有全局热键；无键盘时用悬浮条 |
| 停止快捷键 Ctrl+Alt+S | 悬浮条「停止」/长按主按钮、键盘 Ctrl+Alt+S、通知栏「停止」 | |
| 快捷键可改 + 禁用列表 | 设置里按键录入，同一套禁用规则（常用编辑键、少于两个修饰键的字母键、两键相同） | |
| UI Automation 取光标后文字 | 无障碍服务：当前输入框 textSelectionStart → 读到结尾 | 只能拿到“输入框”里的光标；网页正文没有光标 |
| 选中朗读（UIA GetSelection / Ctrl+C 探测） | 输入框选区 → 任意窗口里有选区的节点 → **选中菜单「光标朗读」(PROCESS_TEXT)** → 分享 | 剪贴板方式在 Android 10+ 后台读不了剪贴板，不做 |
| 小横条窗口（不抢焦点，可拖动，记住位置） | 悬浮朗读条：TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY + FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE（点它不会让输入框丢光标/选区），左侧黑条拖动，位置保存 | 关掉“显示悬浮朗读条”= Windows 的取消置顶 |
| 加载进度条 | 悬浮条底部细进度条 + 主界面百分比（与 Windows 同一估算公式） | |
| 状态：未加载/加载/就绪/取文字/朗读/暂停 | IDLE/LOADING/READING/PAUSED；加载中按主键 = 加载完先暂停（同 Windows） | |
| 标点停顿 ，、0.15 。！？0.5 ；0.3 ：0.25 换行0.5 | 相同默认值、0~3 秒可调 | |
| 语速 0.5~2 ×音色自带 speed | 相同 | 系统 TTS 时再乘阅读 App 的语速 |
| 线程数（默认 2） | 相同（上限=CPU 核数，最多 4） | |
| 切分器（20/36 字、长串→“链接/一串字符”） | 同一份算法（逐字一致的移植，45 条审查用例） | |
| 流式合成、启动缓冲 ≤1 秒、暂停在输出口 | 同；AudioTrack 暂停/继续，缓冲不丢，从停下的字接着读 | |
| 同时只加载一个模型；同模型音色瞬切 | 同（模型指纹相同即复用） | |
| 音色包 voices\<id>\voice.json（同格式） | 内置音色在 APK；导入的在应用私有目录或 Android/data/<包名>/files/voices（数据线拷入也能识别） | 电脑版音色包 zip 直接能导入 |
| 「+」导入音色（任意盘、中文路径） | 「＋导入音色包」(.zip) 和「＋导入文件夹」(系统文件选择器 SAF)；校验同 Windows；重复跳过；同模型硬链接 | 与内置同模型的包只存 voice.json+样音（省 120 MB） |
| 删除音色 = 手动删文件夹 | 长按导入的音色 → 删除（内置不能删） | 手机上用户看不到应用私有目录，只能在应用里删 |
| 试听：音色旁小喇叭播 sample.mp3，试听暂停朗读 | 同；外加“试听当前音色（实时合成）” | |
| 音量统一（gain + tanh 软削波） | 同一算法 | |
| 多音字前端 A 版（jieba+词库A+规则+变调→PUA） | 逐行移植，147k 汉字与 Windows C# 逐字一致 | 约 105 MB Java 堆，largeHeap |
| 用户自定义词库.txt（重启生效） | 应用内编辑器，保存后立即重新加载 | 手机上没有 exe 旁边的文件夹 |
| 关于/第三方许可 | 同（THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES + licenses） | |
| settings.json 宽松读取、原子保存 | SharedPreferences（系统保证原子性），数值有范围限制 | |
| 崩溃日志 log.txt / run_state | 只用 logcat（不写文件、不记录文字内容） | |
| 版本：标准版（Melo+zh-ll#1）/轻量版（Matcha+chaowen） | 同；另出“全音色版”（12 个音色全内置，按 2026-10-13 的安卓双版本决定） | |
| — | 系统 TTS 引擎（v0.1 起），也用多音字前端 | Android 独有 |

## 架构（app/src/main/kotlin/app/caretreader/tts/）
- TextSplitter.kt / SpeechRenderer.kt：与 Windows 相同的切分与合成循环（纯 Kotlin，JVM 测试）。
- PolyphoneFrontend.kt：多音字前端移植（纯 Kotlin）；App.kt 启动时后台加载；OOM 时自动退回旧方式。
- VoicePacks.kt / VoiceLibrary.kt：音色包读取、模型指纹、扫描、zip/文件夹导入、删除。
- Engine.kt / SherpaSynth.kt：全进程唯一引擎（系统 TTS、朗读器共用），一次一个模型，PUA 替换。
- Reader.kt + ReaderService.kt：朗读状态机 + AudioTrack + 前台服务（媒体播放类型，通知栏按钮）+ 音频焦点（来电自动暂停）。
- CaretAccessibilityService.kt + TextGrab.kt：悬浮朗读条、键盘快捷键、无障碍按钮、取文字（密码框不读）。
- ReadTextActivity.kt：选中菜单「光标朗读」与分享入口（无界面，立即关闭）。
- SettingsActivity.kt：主界面（黑白灰、网点纸、圆角）。
- CaretTtsService.kt：系统 TTS 引擎。

## 权限
FOREGROUND_SERVICE、FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK（锁屏继续读）、POST_NOTIFICATIONS（Android 13+ 可选，通知栏按钮）。无障碍服务由用户手动开启。没有 INTERNET、没有存储权限（导入用系统文件选择器）、没有悬浮窗权限（无障碍覆盖层不需要）。

===== Reader.kt =====
package app.caretreader.tts

import android.content.Context
import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.media.AudioTrack
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.Log

/**
 * 光标朗读播放器（对应 Windows 版 MainForm 的朗读状态机 + SpeechPipeline + NAudioSink）。
 *
 * 状态：IDLE → LOADING（加载模型）→ READING ⇄ PAUSED → IDLE。
 * 主操作 toggle()：空闲时由调用方给出文字开始；朗读中 = 暂停；暂停中 = 从暂停处继续。
 * stop()：彻底停止。
 * 暂停在声音输出口里完成（AudioTrack.pause/play），缓冲的声音不丢，从停下的那个字接着读；
 * 暂停时合成线程写不进去就自然停下（最多提前合成约 1 秒 + 当前一句）。
 */
object Reader {
    enum class State { IDLE, LOADING, READING, PAUSED }

    @Volatile var state = State.IDLE
        private set
    /** 给界面/通知看的一句话（例如“朗读选中 · 12 句”“这里没有可以朗读的文字”）。 */
    @Volatile var message: String = ""
        private set
    /** 这次读的是什么（选中的文字 / 光标后的文字 / 分享的文字）。 */
    @Volatile var label: String = ""
        private set

    private val lock = Object()
    private var gen = 0L
    @Volatile private var stopGen = -1L
    @Volatile private var pausedFlag = false
    private var track: AudioTrack? = null
    private var worker: Thread? = null
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val listeners = ArrayList<() -> Unit>()
    private var focusListener: AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener? = null

    fun isActive() = state != State.IDLE

    fun addListener(l: () -> Unit) = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.add(l) }
    fun removeListener(l: () -> Unit) = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.remove(l) }
    private fun changed() {
        val ls = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.toList() }
        main.post { ls.forEach { it() } }
    }

    private fun set(s: State, msg: String? = null) {
        state = s
        if (msg != null) message = msg
        changed()
    }

    /** 只显示一条提示（不改变状态）。 */
    fun notice(msg: String) { message = msg; changed() }

    /**
     * 开始朗读一段文字（正在朗读的会先停掉）。
     * @param label 例如“朗读选中”“从光标处朗读”“朗读分享的文字”
     */
    fun start(ctx: Context, text: String, label: String) {
        val app = ctx.applicationContext
        stop()
        val myGen: Long
        synchronized(lock) {
            myGen = ++gen
            pausedFlag = false
        }
        this.label = label
        val clean = TextGrab.clean(text).take(100_000)
        val prefs = Prefs(app)
        val clauses = TextSplitter.split(clean, prefs.pauses())
        if (clauses.isEmpty()) { set(State.IDLE, "没有可以朗读的文字"); return }
        val voice = Engine.currentVoice(app)
        set(if (Engine.isLoaded(voice, prefs.threads)) State.READING else State.LOADING, "$label · ${voice.name}")
        ReaderService.ensureRunning(app)
        val th = Thread({ run(app, myGen, clauses, voice, prefs) }, "reader")
        th.isDaemon = true
        synchronized(lock) { worker = th }
        th.start()
    }

    /** 主操作（快捷键 / 悬浮条主按钮）：朗读中 → 暂停；暂停中 → 继续；加载中 → 记住“开始后先暂停”。返回 false = 空闲（调用方应去取文字开始朗读）。 */
    fun toggle(): Boolean {
        synchronized(lock) {
            when (state) {
                State.IDLE -> return false
                State.LOADING -> { pausedFlag = !pausedFlag; message = if (pausedFlag) "加载完成后先暂停" else message; changed(); return true }
                State.READING -> { pausedFlag = true; try { track?.pause() } catch (_: Throwable) {}; set(State.PAUSED); return true }
                State.PAUSED -> { pausedFlag = false; try { track?.play() } catch (_: Throwable) {}; (lock as Object).notifyAll(); set(State.READING); return true }
            }
        }
    }

    /** 外部要求暂停（来电、别的 App 抢了声音、试听音色）。 */
    fun pauseIfReading() { if (state == State.READING) toggle() }

    fun stop() {
        synchronized(lock) {
            stopGen = gen
            pausedFlag = false
            try { track?.pause(); track?.flush() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            (lock as Object).notifyAll()
        }
        // 不等合成线程：声音已经立刻停了；正在合成的那一句合成完会被丢弃，线程自己退出（新的朗读会排队等引擎锁）
        if (state != State.IDLE) set(State.IDLE, "已停止")
    }

    private fun run(app: Context, myGen: Long, clauses: List<Clause>, voice: VoiceSpec, prefs: Prefs) {
        val stopped = { stopGen >= myGen }
        var at: AudioTrack? = null
        var written = 0L
        try {
            requestFocus(app)
            Engine.use(app, voice, prefs.threads) { synth ->
                if (stopped()) return@use
                val sr = synth.sampleRate
                val minBuf = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(sr, AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO, AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                val t = AudioTrack.Builder()
                    .setAudioAttributes(AudioAttributes.Builder().setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH).build())
                    .setAudioFormat(AudioFormat.Builder().setSampleRate(sr).setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                        .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO).build())
                    .setBufferSizeInBytes(maxOf(minBuf, sr * 2))     // 约 1 秒
                    .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                    .build()
                at = t
                synchronized(lock) {
                    if (stopped()) return@use
                    track = t
                    if (!pausedFlag) t.play()
                    set(if (pausedFlag) State.PAUSED else State.READING, "$label · ${voice.name}")
                }
                val out = PcmOut { pcm, off, len ->
                    var o = off
                    val end = off + len
                    while (o < end) {
                        if (stopped()) return@PcmOut false
                        if (pausedFlag) { synchronized(lock) { if (pausedFlag && !stopped()) (lock as Object).wait(200) }; continue }
                        val n = t.write(pcm, o, end - o)
                        if (n < 0) return@PcmOut false
                        o += n
                        written += n / 2
                    }
                    true
                }
                val speed = (prefs.speed * voice.speed).coerceIn(0.3f, 4f)
                val st = SpeechRenderer(synth, voice.sid, speed, 1f, 1.0, out, stopped, gain = voice.gain).render(clauses)
                Log.i(TAG, "reader clauses=${st.clauses} first=${st.firstAudioMs}ms rtf=${"%.2f".format(st.rtf)} stopped=${st.stopped}")
                // 等最后的声音播完（暂停时不算时间）
                if (!st.stopped) {
                    var last = -1; var still = 0
                    while (!stopped()) {
                        val head = t.playbackHeadPosition
                        if (head.toLong() and 0xffffffffL >= written) break
                        if (!pausedFlag) { if (head == last) still++ else still = 0; if (still > 40) break }   // 2 秒不动 = 设备异常，结束
                        last = head
                        Thread.sleep(50)
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "reader failed", t)
            if (!stopped()) message = "朗读失败：" + (if (t is OutOfMemoryError) "内存不足" else (t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName))
        } finally {
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (track === at) track = null
                if (gen == myGen) { worker = null }
            }
            try { at?.stop() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            try { at?.release() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            if (gen == myGen) {
                abandonFocus(app)
                val m = if (stopGen >= myGen) "已停止" else if (message.startsWith("朗读失败")) message else "读完了"
                set(State.IDLE, m)
                ReaderService.stopIfIdle(app)
            }
        }
    }

    // ---------------- 音频焦点：来电、别的 App 开始放声音时自动暂停 ----------------
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun requestFocus(ctx: Context) {
        val am = ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE) as AudioManager
        val l = AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener { f ->
            if (f == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS || f == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT) pauseIfReading()
        }
        focusListener = l
        try { am.requestAudioFocus(l, AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun abandonFocus(ctx: Context) {
        val l = focusListener ?: return
        try { (ctx.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE) as AudioManager).abandonAudioFocus(l) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        focusListener = null
    }

    fun stateText(): String = when (state) {
        State.IDLE -> "就绪"
        State.LOADING -> "正在加载音色…"
        State.READING -> "正在朗读"
        State.PAUSED -> "已暂停"
    }

}

package app.caretreader.tts

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import android.util.Log

/**
 * 前台服务：朗读时保持进程不被系统杀掉（锁屏/切到别的 App 也能继续读），
 * 通知栏里有「暂停/继续」「停止」两个按钮（对应 Windows 版的两个快捷键）。
 */
class ReaderService : Service() {
    private val listener: () -> Unit = { update() }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        Reader.addListener(listener)
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        Reader.removeListener(listener)
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        when (intent?.action) {
            ACTION_TOGGLE -> Reader.toggle()
            ACTION_STOP -> Reader.stop()
        }
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29) startForeground(ID, build(), ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK)
            else startForeground(ID, build())
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.w(TAG, "startForeground failed", t)
        }
        if (!Reader.isActive()) { stopForegroundCompat(); stopSelf() }
        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }

    private fun update() {
        if (!Reader.isActive()) { stopForegroundCompat(); stopSelf(); return }
        try { (getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager).notify(ID, build()) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun stopForegroundCompat() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 24) stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE) else stopForeground(true)
    }

    private fun build(): Notification {
        val nm = getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        val b = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL) == null)
                nm.createNotificationChannel(NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "朗读控制", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW).apply {
                    setShowBadge(false); setSound(null, null)
                })
            Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL)
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION") Notification.Builder(this).setPriority(Notification.PRIORITY_LOW)
        }
        val piFlags = PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        fun pi(action: String, code: Int) = PendingIntent.getService(this, code, Intent(this, ReaderService::class.java).setAction(action), piFlags)
        val open = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 3, Intent(this, SettingsActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK), piFlags)
        val paused = Reader.state == Reader.State.PAUSED
        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
        return b.setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_lock_silent_mode_off)
            .setContentTitle(Reader.stateText())
            .setContentText(Reader.message)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
            .setShowWhen(false)
            .setContentIntent(open)
            .addAction(Notification.Action.Builder(null, if (paused) "继续" else "暂停", pi(ACTION_TOGGLE, 1)).build())
            .addAction(Notification.Action.Builder(null, "停止", pi(ACTION_STOP, 2)).build())
            .build()
    }

    companion object {
        const val ACTION_TOGGLE = "app.caretreader.tts.TOGGLE"
        const val ACTION_STOP = "app.caretreader.tts.STOP"
        private const val CHANNEL = "reader"
        private const val ID = 7

        fun ensureRunning(ctx: Context) {
            try {
                val i = Intent(ctx, ReaderService::class.java)
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) ctx.startForegroundService(i) else ctx.startService(i)
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                // Android 12+ 不允许后台启动前台服务的情况：照样朗读（无障碍服务会保持进程），只是没有通知栏按钮
                Log.w(TAG, "前台服务启动失败（照常朗读）", t)
            }
        }

        fun stopIfIdle(ctx: Context) {
            if (Reader.isActive()) return
            try { ctx.stopService(Intent(ctx, ReaderService::class.java)) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
    }
}

package app.caretreader.tts

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityButtonController
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.Log
import android.util.TypedValue
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.KeyEvent
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityEvent
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/**
 * 无障碍服务（Android 上代替 Windows 的 UI Automation + 全局快捷键 + 置顶小窗口）：
 *  - 悬浮朗读条：开始/暂停/继续、停止、设置；左边黑条可以拖动；点它不会抢走输入框的光标和选中。
 *  - 实体键盘快捷键：默认 Ctrl+Alt+R（开始/暂停/继续）、Ctrl+Alt+S（停止），可在设置里改。
 *  - 系统“无障碍按钮/手势”（Android 8+）：点一下 = 开始/暂停/继续。
 *  - 取文字：有选中读选中，没有就从光标处读到结尾（见 TextGrab）。
 */
class CaretAccessibilityService : AccessibilityService() {

    private val INK = Color.rgb(0x11, 0x11, 0x11)
    private val GREY = Color.rgb(0x6B, 0x6B, 0x6B)
    private val HAIR = Color.rgb(0xD9, 0xD9, 0xD9)
    private val WHITE = Color.WHITE

    private var wm: WindowManager? = null
    private var bar: View? = null
    private var lp: WindowManager.LayoutParams? = null
    private var mainBtn: TextView? = null
    private var statusView: TextView? = null
    private var progress: View? = null
    private var progressFill: View? = null
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val readerListener: () -> Unit = { refreshBar() }
    private val engineListener: () -> Unit = { refreshBar() }
    private var buttonCallback: Any? = null
    private val prefsListener = android.content.SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener { _, k ->
        if (k == "floatingBar") main.post { applyBarPref() }
    }

    private fun dp(v: Float) = v * resources.displayMetrics.density
    private fun dpi(v: Float) = dp(v).roundToInt()

    override fun onServiceConnected() {
        super.onServiceConnected()
        instance = this
        wm = getSystemService(WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        Reader.addListener(readerListener)
        Engine.addListener(engineListener)
        getSharedPreferences("settings", MODE_PRIVATE).registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(prefsListener)
        applyBarPref()
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
            val cb = object : AccessibilityButtonController.AccessibilityButtonCallback() {
                override fun onClicked(controller: AccessibilityButtonController) { mainAction() }
            }
            accessibilityButtonController.registerAccessibilityButtonCallback(cb)
            buttonCallback = cb
        }
        App.ensureFrontend(this)
    }

    override fun onAccessibilityEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent?) {}
    override fun onInterrupt() {}

    override fun onDestroy() {
        instance = null
        Reader.removeListener(readerListener)
        Engine.removeListener(engineListener)
        getSharedPreferences("settings", MODE_PRIVATE).unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(prefsListener)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) (buttonCallback as? AccessibilityButtonController.AccessibilityButtonCallback)?.let {
            try { accessibilityButtonController.unregisterAccessibilityButtonCallback(it) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        removeBar()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // ---------------- 快捷键 ----------------
    private var swallowUp = -1

    override fun onKeyEvent(event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
        val p = Prefs(this)
        if (event.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_UP && event.keyCode == swallowUp) { swallowUp = -1; return true }
        if (event.action != KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN || event.repeatCount > 0 || Hotkey.isModifier(event.keyCode)) return false
        val mainKey = Hotkey.parse(p.hotkey)
        val stopKey = Hotkey.parse(p.stopHotkey)
        return when {
            mainKey != null && mainKey.matches(event) -> { swallowUp = event.keyCode; main.post { mainAction() }; true }
            stopKey != null && stopKey.matches(event) -> { swallowUp = event.keyCode; main.post { Reader.stop() }; true }
            else -> false
        }
    }

    /** 主操作：空闲 → 取文字开始；朗读中 → 暂停；暂停 → 继续。 */
    fun mainAction() {
        if (Reader.toggle()) return
        val r = try { TextGrab.grab(this) } catch (t: Throwable) { Log.w(TAG, "grab failed", t); null }
        if (r == null) {
            hint("这里没有找到光标或选中的文字。\n也可以选中文字后在菜单里点「光标朗读」，或用“分享”发给光标朗读。")
            return
        }
        Log.i(TAG, "grab method=${r.method} chars=${r.text.length}")
        if (r.text.isBlank()) { hint(r.label); return }
        Reader.start(this, r.text, r.label)
    }

    private fun hint(msg: String) {
        Reader.notice(msg.lineSequence().first())
        Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    // ---------------- 悬浮朗读条 ----------------
    private fun applyBarPref() { if (Prefs(this).floatingBar) showBar() else removeBar() }

    private fun text(s: String, sp: Float, color: Int, bold: Boolean = false) = TextView(this).apply {
        text = s
        setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, sp)
        setTextColor(color)
        typeface = Typeface.create(if (bold) "sans-serif-medium" else "sans-serif", Typeface.NORMAL)
        includeFontPadding = false
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
    }

    private fun round(fill: Int, stroke: Int?, r: Float) = GradientDrawable().apply {
        setCornerRadius(dp(r)); setColor(fill); if (stroke != null) setStroke(max(1, dp(1f).roundToInt()), stroke)
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private fun showBar() {
        if (bar != null) return
        val w = wm ?: return
        val p = Prefs(this)
        val outer = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            background = round(WHITE, INK, 14f)
            setPadding(0, 0, dpi(6f), 0)
        }
        // 左边黑条 = 拖动把手（和 Windows 版一样）
        val handle = View(this).apply {
            background = GradientDrawable().apply {
                setColor(INK); setCornerRadii(floatArrayOf(dp(14f), dp(14f), 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f, dp(14f), dp(14f)))
            }
            contentDescription = "拖动朗读条"
        }
        outer.addView(handle, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(10f), -1))
        val col = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; setPadding(dpi(8f), dpi(6f), 0, dpi(5f)) }
        val row = LinearLayout(this).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL) }
        val mb = text("开始", 15f, INK, true).apply {
            background = round(WHITE, INK, 10f)
            setOnClickListener { mainAction() }
            setOnLongClickListener { Reader.stop(); true }
        }
        mainBtn = mb
        row.addView(mb, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(72f), dpi(40f)))
        val stop = text("停止", 15f, INK).apply {
            background = round(WHITE, INK, 10f)
            setOnClickListener { Reader.stop() }
        }
        row.addView(stop, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(56f), dpi(40f)).apply { leftMargin = dpi(6f) })
        val more = text("设置", 14f, GREY).apply {
            background = round(WHITE, HAIR, 10f)
            setOnClickListener {
                startActivity(Intent(this@CaretAccessibilityService, SettingsActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK))
            }
        }
        row.addView(more, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(52f), dpi(40f)).apply { leftMargin = dpi(6f) })
        col.addView(row)
        val status = text("", 11f, GREY).apply { gravity = Gravity.START; setSingleLine(true); setPadding(dpi(2f), dpi(5f), 0, 0) }
        statusView = status
        col.addView(status, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(196f), -2))
        val track = FrameLayout(this).apply { background = round(WHITE, INK, 2f); visibility = View.GONE }
        val fill = View(this).apply { setBackgroundColor(INK) }
        track.addView(fill, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1))
        progress = track; progressFill = fill
        col.addView(track, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpi(196f), dpi(5f)).apply { topMargin = dpi(4f) })
        outer.addView(col)

        val type = WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY
        // 不可获得焦点：点朗读条不会让正在编辑的输入框失去光标/选中（对应 Windows 版 WS_EX_NOACTIVATE）
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(-2, -2, type,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT)
        params.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
        val dm = resources.displayMetrics
        params.x = if (p.barX >= 0) p.barX.coerceIn(0, dm.widthPixels - dpi(60f)) else dm.widthPixels - dpi(270f)
        params.y = if (p.barY >= 0) p.barY.coerceIn(0, dm.heightPixels - dpi(60f)) else (dm.heightPixels * 0.62f).toInt()
        lp = params

        var downX = 0f; var downY = 0f; var startX = 0; var startY = 0; var moved = false
        handle.setOnTouchListener { _, e ->
            when (e.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> { downX = e.rawX; downY = e.rawY; startX = params.x; startY = params.y; moved = false; true }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    val dx = e.rawX - downX; val dy = e.rawY - downY
                    if (abs(dx) + abs(dy) > dp(4f)) moved = true
                    params.x = (startX + dx).toInt().coerceIn(0, dm.widthPixels - dpi(40f))
                    params.y = (startY + dy).toInt().coerceIn(0, dm.heightPixels - dpi(40f))
                    try { w.updateViewLayout(outer, params) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> { if (moved) { p.barX = params.x; p.barY = params.y }; true }
                else -> false
            }
        }
        try { w.addView(outer, params); bar = outer } catch (t: Throwable) { Log.e(TAG, "无法显示悬浮朗读条", t) }
        refreshBar()
    }

    private fun removeBar() {
        val b = bar ?: return
        try { wm?.removeView(b) } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        bar = null; mainBtn = null; statusView = null; progress = null; progressFill = null
    }

    private fun refreshBar() {
        val mb = mainBtn ?: return
        val st = Reader.state
        val (label, inverted) = when (st) {
            Reader.State.IDLE -> "开始" to false
            Reader.State.LOADING -> "加载中" to false
            Reader.State.READING -> "暂停" to true
            Reader.State.PAUSED -> "继续" to false
        }
        mb.text = label
        mb.setTextColor(if (inverted) WHITE else INK)
        mb.background = round(if (inverted) INK else WHITE, INK, 10f)
        mb.contentDescription = when (st) {
            Reader.State.IDLE -> "开始朗读：有选中读选中，没有就从光标处读"
            Reader.State.READING -> "暂停朗读"
            Reader.State.PAUSED -> "继续朗读"
            Reader.State.LOADING -> "正在加载音色"
        }
        val p = Prefs(this)
        statusView?.text = when (st) {
            Reader.State.IDLE -> (Reader.message.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it != "读完了" && it != "已停止" }?.let { "$it · " } ?: "就绪 · ") + "${p.hotkey} 朗读"
            Reader.State.LOADING -> Engine.status
            Reader.State.READING -> Reader.label + " · 长按停止"
            Reader.State.PAUSED -> "已暂停 · ${p.hotkey} 继续 · ${p.stopHotkey} 停止"
        }
        val prog = Engine.loadProgress
        val pv = progress; val pf = progressFill
        if (pv != null && pf != null) {
            if (prog >= 0f) {
                pv.visibility = View.VISIBLE
                pf.layoutParams = (pf.layoutParams as FrameLayout.LayoutParams).apply { width = (dpi(196f) * prog).toInt() }
                pf.requestLayout()
            } else pv.visibility = View.GONE
        }
    }

    companion object {
        @Volatile var instance: CaretAccessibilityService? = null
            private set

        fun isEnabled(ctx: android.content.Context): Boolean {
            val s = android.provider.Settings.Secure.getString(ctx.contentResolver, android.provider.Settings.Secure.ENABLED_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICES) ?: return instance != null
            val me = ctx.packageName + "/" + CaretAccessibilityService::class.java.name
            return s.split(':').any { it.equals(me, true) || it.equals(ctx.packageName + "/.CaretAccessibilityService", true) } || instance != null
        }
    }
}

package app.caretreader.tts

import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService
import android.os.Build
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityWindowInfo
import java.util.ArrayDeque

/**
 * 取要朗读的文字（对应 Windows 版 CaretTextGrabber）。
 *
 * 顺序：
 *  1. 当前输入框（有光标的地方）：有选中 → 只读选中；没选中 → 从光标处读到结尾；
 *  2. 屏幕上任何“有选中范围”的文字（可选择文字的阅读页、部分浏览器）→ 只读选中；
 *  3. 读屏焦点（TalkBack 正在指的那一项）→ 读它的文字。
 * 密码框一律不读。只记录方式和字数，不记录文字本身。
 */
object TextGrab {
    class Result(val text: String, val label: String, val method: String)

    fun grab(svc: AccessibilityService): Result? {
        val own = svc.packageName
        val root = svc.rootInActiveWindow
        // 1. 输入焦点
        val focus = try { root?.findFocus(AccessibilityNodeInfo.FOCUS_INPUT) } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
        if (focus != null && focus.packageName?.toString() != own) {
            fromEditable(focus)?.let { return it }
        }
        // 2. 任何窗口里有选中范围的文字
        val roots = ArrayList<AccessibilityNodeInfo>()
        try { svc.windows?.forEach { w -> if (w.type != AccessibilityWindowInfo.TYPE_ACCESSIBILITY_OVERLAY) w.root?.let { roots.add(it) } } } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        if (roots.isEmpty() && root != null) roots.add(root)
        for (r in roots) {
            if (r.packageName?.toString() == own) continue
            findSelection(r)?.let { return it }
        }
        // 3. 读屏焦点
        val a11y = try { root?.findFocus(AccessibilityNodeInfo.FOCUS_ACCESSIBILITY) } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
        if (a11y != null && !a11y.isPassword) {
            val t = nodeText(a11y)
            if (!t.isNullOrBlank()) return Result(t, "朗读读屏焦点", "a11y-focus")
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun showingHint(n: AccessibilityNodeInfo) = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26 && n.isShowingHintText

    private fun nodeText(n: AccessibilityNodeInfo): String? {
        val t = n.text?.toString()
        if (!t.isNullOrBlank() && !showingHint(n)) return t
        return n.contentDescription?.toString()
    }

    private fun fromEditable(n: AccessibilityNodeInfo): Result? {
        if (n.isPassword) return Result("", "密码框不朗读", "password")
        val text = n.text?.toString() ?: return null
        if (text.isEmpty() || showingHint(n)) return null
        var s = n.textSelectionStart; var e = n.textSelectionEnd
        if (s > e) { val x = s; s = e; e = x }
        s = s.coerceIn(-1, text.length); e = e.coerceIn(-1, text.length)
        return when {
            s >= 0 && e > s && text.substring(s, e).isNotBlank() -> Result(text.substring(s, e), "朗读选中", "input-selection")
            s >= 0 && s < text.length && text.substring(s).isNotBlank() -> Result(text.substring(s), "从光标处朗读", "input-caret")
            s >= 0 -> Result("", "光标后面没有文字", "input-caret-end")
            else -> Result(text, "朗读输入框", "input-all")
        }
    }

    /** 广度优先找第一个有选中范围的节点（最多看 4000 个，防止超大页面卡住）。 */
    private fun findSelection(root: AccessibilityNodeInfo): Result? {
        val q = ArrayDeque<AccessibilityNodeInfo>()
        q.add(root)
        var seen = 0
        while (q.isNotEmpty() && seen < 4000) {
            val n = q.poll() ?: break
            seen++
            val s = n.textSelectionStart; val e = n.textSelectionEnd
            if (s >= 0 && e >= 0 && s != e && !n.isPassword) {
                val t = n.text?.toString()
                if (t != null) {
                    val a = minOf(s, e).coerceIn(0, t.length); val b = maxOf(s, e).coerceIn(0, t.length)
                    if (b > a && t.substring(a, b).isNotBlank()) return Result(t.substring(a, b), "朗读选中", "selection")
                }
            }
            for (i in 0 until n.childCount) try { n.getChild(i)?.let { q.add(it) } } catch (_: Throwable) {}
        }
        return null
    }

    /** 和 Windows 版一样清理控制字符：\v \a \f → 换行；U+FFFC（图片占位）和其它控制字符去掉。 */
    fun clean(s: String): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
        for (c in s) {
            when {
                c == '\u000B' || c == '\u0007' || c == '\u000C' || c == '\u2028' || c == '\u2029' -> sb.append('\n')
                c == '\uFFFC' -> {}
                c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' -> sb.append(c)
                Character.isISOControl(c) -> {}
                else -> sb.append(c)
            }
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }
}

package app.caretreader.tts

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.StatFs
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import android.util.Log
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream

/**
 * 音色库（Android 部分）：内置音色 + 导入的音色包，扫描、导入、删除。
 * 对应 Windows 版 VoiceLibrary.Scan + VoiceImporter。
 */
object VoiceLibrary {
    @Volatile private var cached: VoiceCatalog? = null
    private var builtinCache: List<VoiceSpec>? = null
    private var editionName = ""

    /** 导入的音色放这里：应用私有目录（导入按钮）和 Android/data/<包名>/files/voices（用数据线从电脑拷进来）。 */
    fun importDir(ctx: Context) = File(ctx.filesDir, "voices")
    fun externalDir(ctx: Context): File? = ctx.getExternalFilesDir(null)?.let { File(it, "voices") }

    fun catalog(ctx: Context): VoiceCatalog {
        cached?.let { return it }
        synchronized(this) {
            cached?.let { return it }
            return scan(ctx).also { cached = it }
        }
    }

    /** 重新扫描（打开设置页、导入/删除之后）。 */
    fun refresh(ctx: Context): VoiceCatalog = synchronized(this) { cached = null; catalog(ctx) }

    fun builtins(ctx: Context): List<VoiceSpec> {
        builtinCache?.let { return it }
        val am = ctx.applicationContext.assets
        val idx = JSONObject(am.open("voices/index.json").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() })
        editionName = idx.optString("edition", "")
        val arr = idx.getJSONArray("voices")
        val list = ArrayList<VoiceSpec>()
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val e = arr.getJSONObject(i)
            val id = e.getString("id")
            val modelDir = e.getString("modelDir")
            val sizes = e.getJSONObject("sizes")
            val o = VoiceCatalog.parseManifest(am.open("voices/$id/voice.json").bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() })
            val sample = if (e.optBoolean("hasSample", false)) "voices/$id/sample.mp3" else null
            list.add(VoiceCatalog.specFrom(o, id, true, true, modelDir, { sizes.has(it) }, { sizes.optLong(it, 0) },
                sample, true, null) { e.getString("modelKey") })
        }
        builtinCache = list
        return list
    }

    private fun scan(ctx: Context): VoiceCatalog {
        val problems = ArrayList<String>()
        val all = ArrayList<VoiceSpec>()
        val bi = builtins(ctx)
        all.addAll(bi)
        val lookup: (String) -> VoiceSpec? = { dir -> bi.firstOrNull { it.modelDir == dir } }
        for (root in listOfNotNull(importDir(ctx), externalDir(ctx))) {
            val dirs = root.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory && !f.name.startsWith(".") && !f.name.startsWith("_") } ?: continue
            for (d0 in dirs.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() }) {
                // 多套了一层文件夹？看下一层
                val cands = if (File(d0, VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST).isFile) listOf(d0)
                else d0.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory && File(f, VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST).isFile }?.toList() ?: emptyList()
                if (cands.isEmpty()) { problems.add("「${d0.name}」不是音色包（里面没有 voice.json），已跳过"); continue }
                for (d in cands) {
                    try {
                        val v = VoiceCatalog.loadDiskPack(d, lookup)
                        if (all.any { it.id.equals(v.id, true) }) { problems.add("「${v.id}」重复，已跳过"); continue }
                        all.add(v)
                    } catch (t: Throwable) {
                        problems.add("「${d.name}」无法使用：${t.message}")
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        VoiceCatalog.sort(all)
        problems.forEach { Log.w(TAG, "音色库：$it") }
        return VoiceCatalog(editionName, all, problems)
    }

    // =====================================================================
    //  导入（「+」按钮）：选 .zip 音色包，或选一个文件夹
    // =====================================================================
    class ImportResult(val added: List<String>, val skipped: List<String>, val errors: List<String>)

    private const val MAX_TOTAL = 3L shl 30   // 单次最多 3 GB

    /** 导入一个 zip（可以含一个或多个音色包文件夹）。在后台线程调用。 */
    fun importZip(ctx: Context, uri: Uri, progress: (String) -> Unit): ImportResult {
        val tmp = newTemp(ctx)
        try {
            progress("正在解压…")
            var total = 0L
            ctx.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri).use { raw ->
                if (raw == null) throw IllegalArgumentException("无法读取这个文件")
                ZipInputStream(raw.buffered(1 shl 16)).use { z ->
                    while (true) {
                        val e = z.nextEntry ?: break
                        val name = e.name.replace('\\', '/').trimStart('/')
                        if (name.isEmpty() || !VoiceCatalog.safeRel(name)) continue     // 防止“../”跳出目标文件夹
                        val out = File(tmp, name)
                        if (e.isDirectory) { out.mkdirs(); continue }
                        out.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                        FileOutputStream(out).use { o ->
                            val buf = ByteArray(1 shl 16)
                            while (true) {
                                val n = z.read(buf); if (n <= 0) break
                                total += n
                                if (total > MAX_TOTAL) throw IllegalArgumentException("压缩包太大（超过 3 GB）")
                                o.write(buf, 0, n)
                            }
                        }
                        if (total > 0 && (total shr 20) % 20 == 0L) progress("正在解压… ${total shr 20} MB")
                    }
                }
            }
            return installFrom(ctx, tmp, progress)
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            return ImportResult(emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf(if (t is OutOfMemoryError) "内存不足" else (t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName)))
        } finally {
            tmp.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    /** 导入一个文件夹（系统文件选择器选的“树”）。 */
    fun importTree(ctx: Context, tree: Uri, progress: (String) -> Unit): ImportResult {
        val tmp = newTemp(ctx)
        try {
            progress("正在复制…")
            val rootDoc = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(tree)
            var copied = 0L
            fun copy(docId: String, dest: File, depth: Int) {
                if (depth > 4) return
                dest.mkdirs()
                val children = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(tree, docId)
                ctx.contentResolver.query(children, arrayOf(
                    DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID, DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
                    DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_MIME_TYPE), null, null, null)?.use { c ->
                    while (c.moveToNext()) {
                        val id = c.getString(0); val name = c.getString(1) ?: continue; val mime = c.getString(2) ?: ""
                        if (!VoiceCatalog.safeRel(name) || name.contains('/')) continue
                        if (mime == DocumentsContract.Document.MIME_TYPE_DIR) copy(id, File(dest, name), depth + 1)
                        else {
                            ctx.contentResolver.openInputStream(DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(tree, id))?.use { s ->
                                FileOutputStream(File(dest, name)).use { o -> copied += s.copyTo(o, 1 shl 16) }
                            }
                            if (copied > MAX_TOTAL) throw IllegalArgumentException("文件夹太大（超过 3 GB）")
                            progress("正在复制… ${copied shr 20} MB")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            copy(rootDoc, File(tmp, "picked"), 0)
            return installFrom(ctx, tmp, progress)
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            return ImportResult(emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf(t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName))
        } finally {
            tmp.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    private fun newTemp(ctx: Context): File {
        val root = importDir(ctx); root.mkdirs()
        root.listFiles { f -> f.name.startsWith(".import-") }?.forEach { it.deleteRecursively() }   // 上次没清理掉的
        return File(root, ".import-" + System.nanoTime()).also { it.mkdirs() }
    }

    /** 在临时目录里找音色包（本层或往下 3 层），校验后搬进音色库。 */
    private fun installFrom(ctx: Context, tmp: File, progress: (String) -> Unit): ImportResult {
        val packs = tmp.walkTopDown().maxDepth(4).filter { it.isFile && it.name.equals(VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST, true) }.map { it.parentFile!! }.toList()
        if (packs.isEmpty()) return ImportResult(emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf("没有找到音色包（里面应该有 voice.json）"))
        val added = ArrayList<String>(); val skipped = ArrayList<String>(); val errors = ArrayList<String>()
        val root = importDir(ctx)
        var cat = refresh(ctx)
        val bi = builtins(ctx)
        for (p in packs) {
            progress("正在检查 ${p.name}…")
            val spec = try { VoiceCatalog.loadDiskPack(p) { d -> bi.firstOrNull { it.modelDir == d } } } catch (t: Throwable) {
                errors.add("「${p.name}」无法使用：${t.message}"); continue
            }
            if (cat.voices.any { it.modelKey == spec.modelKey && it.sid == spec.sid }) { skipped.add("${spec.name}（已经有了）"); continue }
            val need = p.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile }.sumOf { it.length() }
            if (StatFs(root.absolutePath).availableBytes < need + (50L shl 20)) { errors.add("手机存储空间不够（需要 ${need shr 20} MB）"); continue }
            val o = VoiceCatalog.parseManifest(File(p, VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST).readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
            val dest = uniqueDir(root, VoiceCatalog.safeFolderName(o.optString("id", ""), p.name, p.absolutePath))
            val sameBuiltin = bi.firstOrNull { it.modelKey == spec.modelKey }
            dest.mkdirs()
            if (sameBuiltin != null) {
                // 和内置音色同一个模型：只留说明和试听，模型用内置的那份
                File(p, VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST).copyTo(File(dest, VoiceCatalog.MANIFEST))
                spec.sample?.let { s -> File(s).copyTo(File(dest, File(s).name)) }
                File(dest, VoiceCatalog.BUILTIN_LINK).writeText(sameBuiltin.modelDir)
            } else {
                // 和已导入的音色是同一个模型文件：用硬链接，不重复占空间（做不到就复制）
                val twin = cat.voices.firstOrNull { !it.builtIn && !it.modelInAssets && it.modelKey == spec.modelKey }
                p.walkTopDown().filter { it.isFile }.forEach { f ->
                    val rel = f.relativeTo(p).path
                    val out = File(dest, rel); out.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                    val tw = twin?.let { File(it.modelDir, rel) }
                    var linked = false
                    if (tw != null && tw.isFile && tw.length() == f.length() && f.length() >= (1 shl 20) && sameContent(tw, f)) {
                        linked = try { android.system.Os.link(tw.absolutePath, out.absolutePath); true } catch (_: Throwable) { false }
                    }
                    if (!linked && !f.renameTo(out)) f.copyTo(out, overwrite = true)
                }
            }
            try {
                VoiceCatalog.loadDiskPack(dest) { d -> bi.firstOrNull { it.modelDir == d } }
                added.add(spec.name)
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                dest.deleteRecursively(); errors.add("「${p.name}」复制后校验失败：${t.message}")
            }
            cat = refresh(ctx)
        }
        refresh(ctx)
        return ImportResult(added, skipped, errors)
    }

    private fun sameContent(a: File, b: File): Boolean = sha(a) == sha(b)
    private fun sha(f: File): String {
        val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
        f.inputStream().use { s -> val buf = ByteArray(1 shl 16); while (true) { val n = s.read(buf); if (n <= 0) break; md.update(buf, 0, n) } }
        return md.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
    }

    private fun uniqueDir(root: File, name: String): File {
        var d = File(root, name); var i = 2
        while (d.exists()) { d = File(root, "$name-$i"); i++ }
        return d
    }

    /** 删除一个导入的音色（内置的不能删）。 */
    fun delete(ctx: Context, v: VoiceSpec): Boolean {
        val d = v.packDir ?: return false
        val ok = d.deleteRecursively()
        refresh(ctx)
        return ok
    }

    fun openSample(ctx: Context, v: VoiceSpec): InputStream? = try {
        if (v.sample == null) null else if (v.sampleInAssets) ctx.assets.open(v.sample) else File(v.sample).inputStream()
    } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
}

package app.caretreader.tts

import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsConfig
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsMatchaModelConfig
import com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsModelConfig

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.io.InputStream
import java.security.MessageDigest

// v0.5：音色包（与 Windows v0.4/v0.5 的 voices\<id>\voice.json 格式相同）。
// 不依赖 Android 界面类，JVM 测试里也能用。
//  - 内置音色：APK assets/voices/<id>/(voice.json, sample.mp3)，模型文件在 assets/models/<模型>/（同一模型的多个音色共用一份）。
//  - 导入的音色：<应用私有目录>/voices/<id>/ 或 Android/data/<包名>/files/voices/<id>/，一个文件夹 = 一个音色。
//    如果导入的音色和内置音色是同一个模型，只保存 voice.json + 试听（文件夹里放 builtin_model.txt 指向内置模型），不重复占 120 MB。

class VoiceFiles(
    val model: String, val tokens: String, val lexicon: String?, val vocoder: String?,
    val ruleFsts: List<String>, val puaMap: String?,
)

class VoiceSpec(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val engine: String,          // vits | melo | piper | matcha
    val sid: Int,
    val gain: Float,
    val speed: Float,
    val description: String,
    val order: Int,
    /** 模型文件在 assets 里（true，路径相对 assets）还是在磁盘上（false，绝对路径）。 */
    val modelInAssets: Boolean,
    /** 模型文件所在目录（assets 相对路径或绝对路径）。 */
    val modelDir: String,
    val files: VoiceFiles,
    /** 试听文件：assets 路径（builtIn）或绝对路径；null = 没有试听。 */
    val sample: String?,
    val sampleInAssets: Boolean,
    /** 内置音色（随 APK 安装，不能删除）。 */
    val builtIn: Boolean,
    /** 导入的音色在磁盘上的文件夹（删除用）；内置为 null。 */
    val packDir: File?,
    /** 模型指纹：相同 = 同一个模型，切换音色不用重新加载。 */
    val modelKey: String,
) {
    val isMatcha get() = engine == "matcha"
    fun path(rel: String) = "$modelDir/$rel"
    override fun toString() = name
}

class VoiceCatalog(val edition: String, val voices: List<VoiceSpec>, val problems: List<String>) {
    fun voice(id: String?): VoiceSpec? = voices.firstOrNull { it.id.equals(id, ignoreCase = true) }
    val defaultVoice: VoiceSpec get() = voices[0]

    companion object {
        val ENGINES = listOf("vits", "melo", "piper", "matcha")
        const val MANIFEST = "voice.json"
        const val BUILTIN_LINK = "builtin_model.txt"

        /** 生成 sherpa-onnx 配置。 */
        fun sherpaConfig(v: VoiceSpec, threads: Int): OfflineTtsConfig {
            val f = v.files
            val model = if (v.isMatcha) {
                OfflineTtsModelConfig(
                    matcha = OfflineTtsMatchaModelConfig(
                        acousticModel = v.path(f.model), vocoder = v.path(f.vocoder ?: ""),
                        lexicon = f.lexicon?.let { v.path(it) } ?: "", tokens = v.path(f.tokens),
                    ),
                    numThreads = threads, debug = false, provider = "cpu",
                )
            } else {
                OfflineTtsModelConfig(
                    vits = OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig(model = v.path(f.model), lexicon = f.lexicon?.let { v.path(it) } ?: "", tokens = v.path(f.tokens)),
                    numThreads = threads, debug = false, provider = "cpu",
                )
            }
            return OfflineTtsConfig(model = model, ruleFsts = f.ruleFsts.joinToString(",") { v.path(it) }, maxNumSentences = 1)
        }

        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
        //  voice.json（宽松读取：注释、尾逗号、数字写成字符串、键名大小写都可以）
        // ------------------------------------------------------------------
        fun parseManifest(text: String): JSONObject {
            if (text.length > 256 * 1024) throw IllegalArgumentException("voice.json 太大（不像音色说明文件）")
            var t = text.trimStart('\uFEFF')
            t = stripComments(t).replace(Regex(",\\s*([}\\]])"), "$1")
            return lowerKeys(JSONObject(t))
        }

        private fun stripComments(s: String): String {
            val sb = StringBuilder(s.length)
            var i = 0; var inStr = false
            while (i < s.length) {
                val c = s[i]
                if (inStr) {
                    sb.append(c)
                    if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < s.length) { sb.append(s[i + 1]); i += 2; continue }
                    if (c == '"') inStr = false
                    i++; continue
                }
                if (c == '"') { inStr = true; sb.append(c); i++; continue }
                if (c == '/' && i + 1 < s.length && s[i + 1] == '/') { while (i < s.length && s[i] != '\n') i++; continue }
                if (c == '/' && i + 1 < s.length && s[i + 1] == '*') { val e = s.indexOf("*/", i + 2); i = if (e < 0) s.length else e + 2; continue }
                sb.append(c); i++
            }
            return sb.toString()
        }

        private fun lowerKeys(o: JSONObject): JSONObject {
            val r = JSONObject()
            val it = o.keys()
            while (it.hasNext()) {
                val k = it.next()
                val v = o.get(k)
                r.put(k.lowercase(), if (v is JSONObject) lowerKeys(v) else v)
            }
            return r
        }

        private fun strList(a: JSONArray?) = if (a == null) emptyList() else (0 until a.length()).map { a.optString(it, "") }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }

        /** 相对路径必须留在包里面（不允许 /开头、..）。 */
        fun safeRel(rel: String?): Boolean {
            if (rel.isNullOrBlank()) return false
            if (rel.startsWith("/") || rel.startsWith("\\") || rel.contains(':')) return false
            return rel.replace('\\', '/').split('/').none { it == ".." }
        }

        /**
         * 读一个音色包。exists(rel) / size(rel) 由调用方提供（assets 或磁盘）。成功返回 VoiceSpec，失败抛 IllegalArgumentException（中文原因）。
         */
        fun specFrom(
            o: JSONObject, id: String, builtIn: Boolean, modelInAssets: Boolean, modelDir: String,
            exists: (String) -> Boolean, size: (String) -> Long, sample: String?, sampleInAssets: Boolean,
            packDir: File?, keyOf: (VoiceFiles) -> String,
        ): VoiceSpec {
            val engine = o.optString("engine", "vits").trim().lowercase()
            if (engine !in ENGINES) throw IllegalArgumentException("不支持的引擎类型「$engine」（只支持 vits / melo / piper / matcha）")
            val f = o.optJSONObject("files") ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("voice.json 里缺少 files")
            val model = f.optString("model", "model.onnx")
            val tokens = f.optString("tokens", "tokens.txt")
            val lexicon = f.optString("lexicon", "").ifBlank { null }
            val vocoder = f.optString("vocoder", "").ifBlank { null }
            val pua = f.optString("puamap", "").ifBlank { null }
            if (model.isBlank() || tokens.isBlank()) throw IllegalArgumentException("voice.json 里缺少 files.model 或 files.tokens")
            if (engine == "matcha" && vocoder == null) throw IllegalArgumentException("matcha 音色缺少 files.vocoder（声码器）")
            val sid = o.optInt("sid", 0)
            if (sid < 0) throw IllegalArgumentException("sid 不能是负数")
            val missing = ArrayList<String>()
            fun need(rel: String?, required: Boolean) {
                if (rel == null) { if (required) missing.add("(未填写)"); return }
                if (!safeRel(rel)) { missing.add("$rel（必须在音色包文件夹里）"); return }
                if (!exists(rel)) missing.add(rel)
            }
            need(model, true); need(tokens, true); need(lexicon, false)
            if (engine == "matcha") need(vocoder, true)
            if (missing.isNotEmpty()) throw IllegalArgumentException("缺少文件：" + missing.joinToString("，"))
            val msize = size(model)
            if (msize < 1024) throw IllegalArgumentException("模型文件太小，可能没有下载完整：$model")
            val mb = o.optLong("modelbytes", 0)
            if (mb > 0 && msize != mb) throw IllegalArgumentException("模型文件不完整（应为 $mb 字节，实际 $msize 字节），请重新下载或解压")
            val fsts = strList(f.optJSONArray("rulefsts")).filter { safeRel(it) && exists(it) }
            val puaOk = if (pua != null && safeRel(pua) && exists(pua)) pua else null
            val files = VoiceFiles(model, tokens, lexicon, vocoder, fsts, puaOk)
            fun d(k: String, def: Double): Double { val v = o.optDouble(k, def); return if (v.isNaN() || v <= 0) def else v }
            var name = o.optString("name", "").trim().ifEmpty { id }
            if (name.length > 40) name = name.substring(0, 40)
            return VoiceSpec(
                id = id, name = name, engine = engine, sid = sid,
                gain = d("gain", 1.0).coerceIn(0.1, 5.0).toFloat(), speed = d("speed", 1.0).coerceIn(0.5, 2.0).toFloat(),
                description = o.optString("description", ""), order = o.optInt("order", 100),
                modelInAssets = modelInAssets, modelDir = modelDir, files = files,
                sample = sample, sampleInAssets = sampleInAssets, builtIn = builtIn, packDir = packDir,
                modelKey = keyOf(files),
            )
        }

        /** 模型指纹：引擎类型 + 大小 + 模型开头/中间/结尾各 1MB 的 SHA-256（与 Windows 版同一思路）。 */
        fun modelKey(engine: String, files: VoiceFiles, size: (String) -> Long, readRange: (String, Long, Int) -> ByteArray): String {
            val len = size(files.model)
            val sha = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            val chunk = 1 shl 20
            for (pos in linkedSetOf(0L, maxOf(0L, len / 2 - chunk / 2), maxOf(0L, len - chunk))) sha.update(readRange(files.model, pos, chunk))
            val h = sha.digest().joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }.substring(0, 24)
            fun sz(r: String?) = if (r == null) "-" else size(r).toString()
            val kind = if (engine == "matcha") "matcha" else "vits"
            return "$kind|$len|$h|${sz(files.tokens)}|${sz(files.lexicon)}|${if (engine == "matcha") sz(files.vocoder) else ""}|${files.ruleFsts.joinToString(",")}|${sz(files.puaMap)}"
        }

        fun readRangeFile(f: File, pos: Long, n: Int): ByteArray {
            java.io.RandomAccessFile(f, "r").use { r ->
                if (pos >= r.length()) return ByteArray(0)
                r.seek(pos)
                val b = ByteArray(minOf(n.toLong(), r.length() - pos).toInt())
                r.readFully(b)
                return b
            }
        }

        fun readRangeStream(open: () -> InputStream, pos: Long, n: Int): ByteArray = open().use { s ->
            var skip = pos
            while (skip > 0) { val k = s.skip(skip); if (k <= 0) break; skip -= k }
            val b = ByteArray(n); var got = 0
            while (got < n) { val k = s.read(b, got, n - got); if (k <= 0) break; got += k }
            b.copyOf(got)
        }

        /** 磁盘上的一个音色包文件夹 → VoiceSpec。builtinResolver(模型目录名) 用于 builtin_model.txt。 */
        fun loadDiskPack(dir: File, builtinLookup: (String) -> VoiceSpec?): VoiceSpec {
            val mf = File(dir, MANIFEST)
            if (!mf.isFile) throw IllegalArgumentException("缺少 voice.json")
            val o = parseManifest(mf.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
            val sampleRel = o.optString("sample", "sample.mp3")
            val sample = if (safeRel(sampleRel) && File(dir, sampleRel).isFile) File(dir, sampleRel).absolutePath else null
            val link = File(dir, BUILTIN_LINK)
            if (link.isFile) {
                // 和内置音色共用模型：模型路径 = 内置的那份
                val key = link.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
                val base = builtinLookup(key) ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("它依赖的内置模型（$key）在这个版本里没有")
                return VoiceSpec(
                    id = dir.name, name = o.optString("name", "").trim().ifEmpty { dir.name }.take(40), engine = base.engine,
                    sid = o.optInt("sid", 0).coerceAtLeast(0),
                    gain = o.optDouble("gain", 1.0).let { if (it.isNaN() || it <= 0) 1.0 else it }.coerceIn(0.1, 5.0).toFloat(),
                    speed = o.optDouble("speed", 1.0).let { if (it.isNaN() || it <= 0) 1.0 else it }.coerceIn(0.5, 2.0).toFloat(),
                    description = o.optString("description", ""), order = o.optInt("order", 100),
                    modelInAssets = base.modelInAssets, modelDir = base.modelDir, files = base.files,
                    sample = sample, sampleInAssets = false, builtIn = false, packDir = dir, modelKey = base.modelKey,
                )
            }
            fun ex(r: String) = File(dir, r).isFile
            fun sz(r: String) = File(dir, r).length()
            return specFrom(o, dir.name, false, false, dir.absolutePath, ::ex, ::sz, sample, false, dir) { files ->
                modelKey(o.optString("engine", "vits").lowercase(), files, ::sz) { r, p, n -> readRangeFile(File(dir, r), p, n) }
            }
        }

        /** 排序：order 小的在前，其次按名字。 */
        fun sort(list: MutableList<VoiceSpec>) = list.sortWith(compareBy<VoiceSpec>({ it.order }, { it.name }))

        /** 文件夹名只用英文字母、数字、- _ .（原生库对英文路径最稳）。 */
        fun safeFolderName(preferred: String?, fallback: String?, seed: String): String {
            for (s in listOf(preferred, fallback)) {
                if (s.isNullOrBlank()) continue
                val chars = s.trim().map { if (it in 'a'..'z' || it in 'A'..'Z' || it in '0'..'9' || it == '-' || it == '_' || it == '.') it else '-' }
                var t = String(chars.toCharArray()).trim('-', '.', ' ')
                while (t.contains("--")) t = t.replace("--", "-")
                if (t.length > 40) t = t.substring(0, 40).trimEnd('-', '.')
                if (t.length >= 2 && chars.count { it != '-' } * 2 >= s.trim().length) return t
            }
            val h = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(seed.toByteArray()).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
            return "voice-" + h.substring(0, 8)
        }
    }
}

const val TAG = "CaretTts"

/** 引擎设置（保存在 SharedPreferences，设置界面和朗读服务共用）。 */
class Prefs(ctx: Context) {
    private val sp: SharedPreferences = ctx.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences("settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

    var voiceId: String?
        get() = sp.getString("voice", null)
        set(v) = sp.edit().putString("voice", v).apply()
    var speed: Float
        get() = sp.getFloat("speed", 1.0f).coerceIn(0.5f, 2.0f)
        set(v) = sp.edit().putFloat("speed", v.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.0f)).apply()
    var threads: Int
        // 不超过手机的 CPU 核数（老手机可能只有 4 核里 2 个大核，开太多线程反而更慢）
        get() = sp.getInt("threads", 2).coerceIn(1, maxThreads())
        set(v) = sp.edit().putInt("threads", v.coerceIn(1, 4)).apply()

    /** 实体键盘快捷键（v0.5，对应 Windows 的全局快捷键）："Ctrl+Alt+R" 这种格式。 */
    var hotkey: String
        get() = sp.getString("hotkey", "Ctrl+Alt+R") ?: "Ctrl+Alt+R"
        set(v) = sp.edit().putString("hotkey", v).apply()
    var stopHotkey: String
        get() = sp.getString("stopHotkey", "Ctrl+Alt+S") ?: "Ctrl+Alt+S"
        set(v) = sp.edit().putString("stopHotkey", v).apply()
    /** 悬浮朗读条（需要开启无障碍服务）。对应 Windows 的“窗口总在最前面”。 */
    var floatingBar: Boolean
        get() = sp.getBoolean("floatingBar", true)
        set(v) = sp.edit().putBoolean("floatingBar", v).apply()
    var barX: Int
        get() = sp.getInt("barX", -1)
        set(v) = sp.edit().putInt("barX", v).apply()
    var barY: Int
        get() = sp.getInt("barY", -1)
        set(v) = sp.edit().putInt("barY", v).apply()

    fun pause(key: String): Float = sp.getFloat("p_$key", DEFAULT_PAUSES.getValue(key)).coerceIn(0f, 3f)
    fun setPause(key: String, v: Float) = sp.edit().putFloat("p_$key", v.coerceIn(0f, 3f)).apply()

    fun pauses() = PauseSettings(
        comma = r(pause("comma")), period = r(pause("period")), semicolon = r(pause("semicolon")),
        colon = r(pause("colon")), newline = r(pause("newline")),
    )

    /** 恢复默认（音色不动）。 */
    fun resetNumbers() {

        for (k in DEFAULT_PAUSES.keys) e.remove("p_$k")
        e.apply()
    }

    private fun r(f: Float) = Math.round(f * 100) / 100.0

    companion object {
        fun maxThreads() = Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors().coerceIn(1, 4)
        val DEFAULT_PAUSES = linkedMapOf(

/**
 * 全进程唯一的语音引擎（系统 TTS 服务、光标朗读播放器、试听共用）。
 *  - 同一时间只加载一个模型（换到另一个模型的音色时，先释放旧模型再加载新模型，内存峰值≈一个模型）。
 *  - 同一模型里的不同音色（模型指纹相同）切换不需要重新加载。
 *  - 内置模型直接从 APK 的 assets 里读取；导入的音色从手机存储读取。
 *  - v0.5：多音字前端（与 Windows v0.5 相同的词库 A 版）把汉字换成音色包词典里的私用区字符。
 */
object Engine {
    private val lock = ReentrantLock()
    private var tts: OfflineTts? = null
    private var synth: SherpaSynth? = null
    private var loadedKey: String? = null

    /** 给界面看的状态文字。 */
    @Volatile var status: String = "未加载"
        private set
    /** 正在加载时的大致进度（0~1）；不在加载时为 -1。 */
    @Volatile var loadProgress: Float = -1f
        private set
    private val listeners = ArrayList<() -> Unit>()
    private val main = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    fun catalog(ctx: Context): VoiceCatalog = VoiceLibrary.catalog(ctx)

    fun currentVoice(ctx: Context): VoiceSpec {
        val cat = catalog(ctx)
        return cat.voice(Prefs(ctx).voiceId) ?: cat.defaultVoice
    }

    fun addListener(l: () -> Unit) = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.add(l) }
    fun removeListener(l: () -> Unit) = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.remove(l) }
    private fun notifyListeners() {
        val ls = synchronized(listeners) { listeners.toList() }
        main.post { ls.forEach { it() } }
    }
    private fun setStatus(s: String) { status = s; notifyListeners() }

    /** 在引擎锁内使用指定音色所在的模型（必要时加载）。 */
    fun <T> use(ctx: Context, voice: VoiceSpec, threads: Int, block: (SherpaSynth) -> T): T {
        lock.lock()
        try {
            return block(ensureLoaded(ctx, voice, threads))
        } finally {
            lock.unlock()
        }
    }

    fun isLoaded(voice: VoiceSpec, threads: Int) = loadedKey == "${voice.modelKey}/$threads"

    private val preloadQueued = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
    @Volatile private var preloadVoice: VoiceSpec? = null

    /** 后台预加载（设置界面换音色、服务启动时调用），让第一次朗读更快。 */
    fun preloadAsync(ctx: Context, voice: VoiceSpec? = null) {
        val app = ctx.applicationContext
        if (voice != null) preloadVoice = voice
        if (!preloadQueued.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        thread(name = "tts-preload", isDaemon = true) {
            try {
                lock.lock(); lock.unlock()
                preloadQueued.set(false)
                val v = preloadVoice ?: currentVoice(app)
                preloadVoice = null
                use(app, v, Prefs(app).threads) { }
            } catch (t: Throwable) {
                preloadQueued.set(false)
                Log.e(TAG, "preload failed", t)
            }
        }
    }

    /** 释放模型（正在朗读则不释放）。 */
    fun releaseIfIdle(reason: String) {
        if (Reader.isActive()) return
        if (lock.tryLock()) {
            try {
                if (tts == null) return
                freeLocked()
                setStatus("已释放（$reason）")
            } finally {
                lock.unlock()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun freeLocked() {
        tts?.release()
        tts = null
        synth = null
        loadedKey = null
    }

    private fun ensureLoaded(ctx: Context, voice: VoiceSpec, threads: Int): SherpaSynth {
        val key = "${voice.modelKey}/$threads"
        synth?.let { if (loadedKey == key) return it }

        freeLocked()          // 先释放旧模型，内存里永远只有一个
        setStatus("正在加载 ${voice.name} …")
        val t0 = System.nanoTime()
        // sherpa-onnx 没有加载进度回调：按经验时间估算（和 Windows 版一样），最多走到 95%
        val approx = if (voice.engine == "melo") 4.0 else if (voice.isMatcha) 3.0 else 2.0
        loadProgress = 0f
        val ticker = thread(name = "load-progress", isDaemon = true) {
            try {
                while (loadProgress >= 0f) {
                    val t = (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1e9
                    loadProgress = minOf(0.95f, (1 - Math.exp(-t / (0.6 * approx))).toFloat())
                    notifyListeners()
                    Thread.sleep(150)
                }
            } catch (_: InterruptedException) {}
        }
        try {
            val app = ctx.applicationContext
            val config = VoiceCatalog.sherpaConfig(voice, threads)
            val t = OfflineTts(assetManager = if (voice.modelInAssets) app.assets else null, config = config)
            val pua = voice.files.puaMap?.let { rel ->
                try {
                    (if (voice.modelInAssets) app.assets.open(voice.path(rel)) else java.io.File(voice.path(rel)).inputStream()).use { PuaMap.parse(it) }
                } catch (e: Throwable) { Log.w(TAG, "pua_map 读取失败", e); null }
            }
            val s = SherpaSynth(t, pua) { Log.i(TAG, it) }
            s.synth("你好", voice.sid, 1.0f)       // 预热
            tts = t; synth = s; loadedKey = key
            val ms = (System.nanoTime() - t0) / 1_000_000
            Log.i(TAG, "loaded ${voice.id} (${voice.modelDir}) threads=$threads in ${ms}ms sr=${s.sampleRate} pua=${pua?.size ?: 0}")
            loadProgress = -1f
            setStatus("已就绪（加载 ${"%.1f".format(ms / 1000.0)} 秒）")
            return s
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "load ${voice.id} failed", t)
            freeLocked()
            loadProgress = -1f
            setStatus("加载失败：${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}")
            throw t
        } finally {
            loadProgress = -1f
            ticker.interrupt()
        }
    }
}

        return try {

            if (!loggedFirst) { loggedFirst = true; log("多音字前端：已启用（本句 ${r.count { it in '\uE000'..'\uF8FF' }}/${text.length} 个字按定好的读音朗读）") }
            r
        } catch (t: Throwable) { log("多音字前端出错，这一句按原文朗读：$t"); text }
    }

package app.caretreader.tts

import android.view.KeyEvent

/**
 * 实体键盘快捷键（蓝牙/USB 键盘、平板键盘盖）。格式和 Windows 版一样："Ctrl+Alt+R"。
 * 只有开启了无障碍服务才能在任何 App 里生效（系统把按键先交给无障碍服务过滤）。
 */
data class Hotkey(val ctrl: Boolean, val alt: Boolean, val shift: Boolean, val meta: Boolean, val keyCode: Int) {
    val modifierCount get() = listOf(ctrl, alt, shift, meta).count { it }

    fun matches(e: KeyEvent): Boolean =
        e.keyCode == keyCode && e.isCtrlPressed == ctrl && e.isAltPressed == alt && e.isShiftPressed == shift && e.isMetaPressed == meta

    override fun toString(): String {
        val p = ArrayList<String>()
        if (ctrl) p.add("Ctrl"); if (alt) p.add("Alt"); if (shift) p.add("Shift"); if (meta) p.add("Win")
        p.add(keyName(keyCode))
        return p.joinToString("+")
    }

    companion object {
        private val NAMES = mapOf(
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE to "Space", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER to "Enter", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB to "Tab",
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE to "Esc", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL to "Back", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL to "Del",
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_INSERT to "Insert", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_HOME to "Home", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_END to "End",
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_UP to "PgUp", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_DOWN to "PgDn",
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT to "Left", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT to "Right",
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP to "Up", KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN to "Down",
        )

        fun keyName(code: Int): String {
            NAMES[code]?.let { return it }
            if (code in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Z) return ('A' + (code - KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A)).toString()
            if (code in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_9) return ('0' + (code - KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0)).toString()
            if (code in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F1..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F12) return "F" + (code - KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F1 + 1)
            return KeyEvent.keyCodeToString(code).removePrefix("KEYCODE_")
        }

        private fun codeOf(name: String): Int? {
            val n = name.trim()
            NAMES.entries.firstOrNull { it.value.equals(n, true) }?.let { return it.key }
            if (n.length == 1 && n[0].uppercaseChar() in 'A'..'Z') return KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A + (n[0].uppercaseChar() - 'A')
            if (n.length == 1 && n[0] in '0'..'9') return KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0 + (n[0] - '0')
            if (n.length in 2..3 && (n[0] == 'F' || n[0] == 'f')) n.substring(1).toIntOrNull()?.let { if (it in 1..12) return KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F1 + it - 1 }
            val c = KeyEvent.keyCodeFromString("KEYCODE_" + n.uppercase())
            return if (c > 0) c else null
        }

        fun parse(s: String?): Hotkey? {
            if (s.isNullOrBlank()) return null
            var ctrl = false; var alt = false; var shift = false; var meta = false; var key: Int? = null
            for (p in s.split('+').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }) {
                when (p.lowercase()) {
                    "ctrl", "control" -> ctrl = true
                    "alt" -> alt = true
                    "shift" -> shift = true
                    "win", "meta", "cmd" -> meta = true
                    else -> key = codeOf(p) ?: return null
                }
            }
            return Hotkey(ctrl, alt, shift, meta, key ?: return null)
        }

        fun isModifier(code: Int) = code in setOf(
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CTRL_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CTRL_RIGHT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ALT_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ALT_RIGHT,
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SHIFT_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SHIFT_RIGHT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_META_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_META_RIGHT,
            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FUNCTION, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_CAPS_LOCK, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUM_LOCK, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SCROLL_LOCK,
        )

        fun from(e: KeyEvent) = Hotkey(e.isCtrlPressed, e.isAltPressed, e.isShiftPressed, e.isMetaPressed, e.keyCode)

        /**
         * 不能用的组合（和 Windows 版 Hotkey.Problem 同一套规则）：复制/粘贴/撤销等常用键、编辑和光标移动键、
         * 少于两个修饰键的字母/数字/符号键。返回中文原因；没问题返回 null。
         */
        fun problem(h: Hotkey, other: Hotkey?): String? {
            val k = h.keyCode
            val name = h.toString()
            if (h.modifierCount == 0 && k !in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F1..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F12) return "$name 是普通按键，打字时会误触，请至少加两个修饰键（如 Ctrl+Alt）"
            val onlyCtrl = h.ctrl && !h.alt && !h.shift && !h.meta
            val onlyAlt = h.alt && !h.ctrl && !h.shift && !h.meta
            if (onlyCtrl && k in listOf(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_C, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_V, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_X, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Z, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Y,
                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_S, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_INSERT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE)) return "$name 是常用的系统/编辑快捷键"
            if (onlyAlt && k in listOf(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F4, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER)) return "$name 是系统快捷键"
            if (h.ctrl && h.alt && !h.shift && !h.meta && k in listOf(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB)) return "$name 是系统快捷键"
            if (h.ctrl && h.shift && !h.alt && !h.meta && k == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE) return "$name 是系统快捷键"
            val editing = listOf(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_END, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MOVE_HOME, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_UP, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_PAGE_DOWN,
                KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_TAB, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE)
            if (k in editing && !h.alt && !h.meta) return "$name 是编辑/移动光标用的键"
            val printable = k in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Z || k in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_0..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_9 ||
                k in KeyEvent.KEYCODE_GRAVE..KeyEvent.KEYCODE_AT || k == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE
            if (printable && h.modifierCount < 2) return "$name 只有一个修饰键，容易和其它 App 的快捷键冲突，请用两个（如 Ctrl+Alt+${keyName(k)}）"
            if (other != null && other == h) return "开始/暂停 和 停止 不能用同一个快捷键"
            return null
        }
    }
}

    }

    companion object {
        /** 用户自定义词库（对应 Windows 版 exe 旁边的 用户自定义词库.txt）。第一次运行时从 APK 里复制一份默认的。 */
        fun userDictFile(ctx: Context): File {
            val f = File(ctx.filesDir, "user_dict.txt")
            if (!f.exists()) try {
                ctx.assets.open("frontend/user_dict_default.txt").use { s -> f.outputStream().use { s.copyTo(it) } }
            } catch (t: Throwable) { Log.w(TAG, "默认用户词库复制失败", t) }
            return f
        }

        private fun opener(ctx: Context): (String) -> java.io.InputStream {
            val am = ctx.applicationContext.assets
            return { name -> am.open("frontend/$name") }
        }

        fun ensureFrontend(ctx: Context) {
            val app = ctx.applicationContext
            PolyphoneFrontend.startLoading(opener(app), { readUserDict(app) }) { Log.i(TAG, it) }
        }

        fun reloadFrontend(ctx: Context) {
            val app = ctx.applicationContext
            Thread { PolyphoneFrontend.reload(opener(app), { readUserDict(app) }) { Log.i(TAG, it) } }.start()
        }

        private fun readUserDict(ctx: Context): String? = try { userDictFile(ctx).readText(Charsets.UTF_8) } catch (_: Throwable) { null }
    }
}
